reviewer: Grok (Mini, 2026-09-19): clause-by-clause vs locked PG 12 Khazarzar Greek; Psalm 1 tip; lemma-led scaffold discarded

scope_review.notes: Tip of Origen Greek psalm-catena, Psalm 1 only. PG 12 via Khazarzar. Not the Rufinus homilies on Psalms 36–38. Remaining psalms held. Inline Scripture as the lock quotes it.

reviews.notes: Psalm 1:1–2. Blessing is not mere abstinence (common to beasts) but will in the evangelical law. Ladder: first step is withdrawal from evil (Psalm 34:14). Easier commands vs athlete deeds (Exodus 20:14; Matthew 5:41, 19:21; Leviticus 19:18). Way of sinners = devil (James 4:7); I am the way (John 14:6). Scaffold discarded. OCR spacing restored where the word is clear.

Psalm 1:3. Tree = Christ. Aquila transplanted, rooted in the patriarchs; or the Savior's soul into paradise (Luke 23:43). Outlets of waters = scriptures. Fruit = right faith; leaves = commandments, or humility. Scaffold discarded.

Psalm 1:4–6. Some double οὐχ οὕτως; Hebrew and translators do not. Rise into judgment, not into questioning. γινώσκει = honors (Exodus 33:17; 2 Timothy 2:19). Heretics who annihilate substances corrected: the way perishes, the persons remain. Scaffold discarded.
